body.statement: The map \(F_{p,M_8,a_{\min}}\) is globally Lipschitz on \([-\sqrt{V_8},\sqrt{V_8}]^{d_4}\), and the quotient modulus \(C_{\mathrm{Lap}}\) is finite. This bound holds across the maximum-floor kink and the spectral-clipping eigenvalue kinks because the maximum is Lipschitz, the fourth-root and reciprocal powers are Lipschitz above the positive floor, the intervening moment maps are polynomials on a compact cube, and spectral projection is nonexpansive in Frobenius norm.
body.justification: A global modulus is required because derivative suprema do not control the nonsmooth floor and spectral projection at their kinks.
body.gap: Fourth-moment ICA limit theory is local; this lemma supplies the finite-sample global propagation bound needed by the bounded construction.
body.consumer: It validates a single finite-sample radius for every law in the literal-Laplace class.
